newsitem.title: USA: Sprint signs agreement with NEC.
newsitem.headline: Sprint signs agreement with NEC.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Wednesday it signed an agreement with NEC America under which NEC will be Sprint's primary provider of asynchronous transfer mode (ATM) core backbone switches.
The switches expand telephone network capacity and increases the amount of data and voice that can be carried on Sprint's lines, the company said.
Sprint, with NEC, has installed eight ATOMNET/M20 ATM switches over the last two years, with further deployment based on customer demand.
NEC America is a unit of NEC Corp.
Sprint is a global communications company.
